main.description: A review of another profile, kept in the reviewer's own folder. Only who it is about is required: a review can be as thin as pointing at a person. What is missing weighs less; nothing is refused. Its market is the market of the profile it is about.

media.description: Optional. Photos and short videos of the work.

dealId.description: The deal this review is about: the escrow account's address (base58) when an escrow exists, else 32 random bytes as lowercase hex, chosen when the deal began. Two reviews across one deal id are the two sides' receipts. Optional; an index weighs a review without one, or without evidence under it, near zero.

ratings.description: Optional. Ratings by name, each from 1.0 to 10.0 with at most one decimal, as decimal text ("8.5"), since a record holds no fractional numbers. Any name may be used; overall by convention, and a market file suggests others.
